label: Matt 9:1
text: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.

label: Matt 9:2
text:
Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic,
“Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

label: Matt 9:3
text: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

label: Matt 9:4
text:
Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said,
“Why do you think evil in your hearts?

label: Matt 9:5
text: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk?’

label: Matt 9:6
text:
But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins-” (then he said to the paralytic),
“Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

label: Matt 9:7
text: He arose and departed to his house.

label: Matt 9:8
text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

label: Matt 9:9
text:
As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him,
“Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

label: Matt 9:10
text: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

label: Matt 9:11
text: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

label: Matt 9:12
text:
When Jesus heard it, he said to them,
“Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

label: Matt 9:13
text:
But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’
for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

label: Matt 9:14
text: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

label: Matt 9:15
text:
Jesus said to them,
“Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

label: Matt 9:16
text: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

label: Matt 9:17
text: Neither do people put new wine into old wine skins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.”

label: Matt 9:18
text: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

label: Matt 9:19
text: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

label: Matt 9:20
text: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

label: Matt 9:21
text: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

label: Matt 9:22
text:
But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said,
“Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

label: Matt 9:23
text: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,

label: Matt 9:24
text:
he said to them,
“Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
They were ridiculing him.

label: Matt 9:25
text: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

label: Matt 9:26
text: The report of this went out into all that land.

label: Matt 9:27
text: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

label: Matt 9:28
text:
When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them,
“Do you believe that I am able to do this?”
They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

label: Matt 9:29
text:
Then he touched their eyes, saying,
“According to your faith be it done to you.”

label: Matt 9:30
text:
Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying,
“See that no one knows about this.”

label: Matt 9:31
text: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

label: Matt 9:32
text: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

label: Matt 9:33
text: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

label: Matt 9:34
text: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

label: Matt 9:35
text: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

label: Matt 9:36
text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

label: Matt 9:37
text:
Then he said to his disciples,
“The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

label: Matt 9:38
text: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

label: The return crossing to 'his own city' (Capernaum)
statement: After the Gadarene episode Jesus crossed back by boat and came into his own city, Capernaum (Matt 4:13).

label: A paralytic lying on a bed was carried to Jesus
statement: A paralytic lying on a bed (krabattos) was carried to Jesus in Capernaum.

label: Scribes reasoned that forgiving sins was blasphemy
statement: Some scribes reasoned within themselves that Jesus' claim to forgive sins was blasphemy.

label: The Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins
statement: Jesus declared that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins, and told the paralytic to take up his mat and walk.

label: Matthew sat at the tax-collection office in Capernaum
statement: Matthew sat at the tax-collection office (telonion) in Capernaum - a toll or customs point - and was called by Jesus to follow him.

label: Jesus ate with tax collectors and sinners; Pharisees objected
statement: Many tax collectors and sinners reclined at table with Jesus and his disciples, and Pharisees objected to the teacher eating with them.

label: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice' quoted
statement: Jesus quoted Hosea 6:6, 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice', against the objectors.

label: John's disciples and the Pharisees fasted
statement: John's disciples and the Pharisees practised fasting while Jesus' disciples did not while the bridegroom is with them.

label: Unshrunk cloth on an old garment
statement: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or the patch tears away and the hole worsens.

label: New wine in fresh wineskins
statement: New wine is put into fresh wineskins, not old ones, or the skins burst and both wine and skins are ruined.

label: A synagogue ruler came about his dead daughter
statement: A ruler (of the synagogue, archisynagogos) came and asked Jesus to lay his hand on his daughter, who had just died.

label: The haemorrhaging woman touched the fringe (tzitzit)
statement: A woman with a twelve-year haemorrhage came behind Jesus and touched the fringe (tzitzit) of his garment.

label: Flute players and a wailing crowd at the ruler's house
statement: At the ruler's house Jesus saw flute players and a crowd in noisy disorder - professional mourners at a death.

label: Reports of the healings spread through all that land
statement: The report of the raisings and healings went out and spread through all that land.

label: Two blind men called Jesus 'Son of David'
statement: Two blind men followed Jesus calling, 'Have mercy on us, Son of David', and were healed.

label: A mute demoniac was brought and healed
statement: A mute man possessed by a demon was brought to Jesus; when the demon was cast out the mute man spoke.

label: 'By the prince of the demons he casts out demons'
statement: The Pharisees said that Jesus casts out demons by the prince of the demons (Beelzebul).

label: Teaching in the synagogues of cities and villages
statement: Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news of the Kingdom.

label: The crowds like sheep without a shepherd
statement: Jesus was moved with compassion for the harassed and scattered crowds, like sheep without a shepherd.

label: The harvest is plentiful; pray for labourers
statement: Jesus told his disciples the harvest is plentiful but the labourers are few, and to pray the Lord of the harvest to send out labourers.
